scenes.text: Did you know that if an apocalypse wipes out our digital world tomorrow, all of your favorite music could survive on a piece of glass?
Deep inside an Arctic mountain, scientists are building a Doomsday Vault to laser-etch master recordings onto tiny plates of silica glass.
This glass can withstand solar flares, radiation, and extreme temperatures, preserving our cultural soundtrack for over ten thousand years.
If you could save just one song from being lost forever, what would it be? Tell me below and follow for more.
